input:
Earlier scenes:
古代的时候，有一个男孩名字叫孟子。孟子和孟子的妈妈两个人住在很穷的农村。他们住的地方旁边是个墓地，墓地老是有很多人祭拜。因为人们在祭拜，他们一直在哭。孟子和孟子的妈妈住在这里才一个星期就觉得受不了了，而且害得孟子的学习。

This scene:
孟子的妈妈觉得孟子取得良好的教育是很重要的，所以孟子的妈妈认为这样的地方对儿子的教育不太好，就打算跟孟子搬家。孟子的妈妈带孟子不是搬到城市，而是搬到了孟子老师的家。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 所以孟子的妈妈认为这样的地方对儿子的教育不太好：replace孟子的妈妈with她
- 不是搬到城市，而是搬到了孟子老师的家：家里

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 取得良好的教育：接受良好的教育，The verb does not naturally collocate with education here; this version expresses receiving an education. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟孟子搬家：带着孟子搬家，This action means that the mother takes her son with her when moving; the original wording incorrectly suggests that they move as equal partners. [vocab list]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 不是搬到城市，而是搬到了孟子老师的家：搬到了孟子老师的家，This paired structure is for correcting or refuting an established, usually expected claim. No earlier claim says that they will move to the city. [rule: bushi_ershi_construction]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子的妈妈认为：她认为，Use a pronoun when the same character was named very recently and no competing person makes the reference unclear. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子的妈妈带孟子：她带孟子，The mother is the close re-occurrence from the preceding sentence, so a pronoun avoids unnecessarily repeating her name. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
6. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 。孟子的妈妈带孟子搬到了孟子老师的家。：，于是她带孟子搬到了孟子老师的家。，“于是” marks the sequence and result: after deciding to move, the mother carries out the move. [rule: coherence_connectives]

items.reason: “取得教育” is not the appropriate collocation here; “接受良好的教育” is correct.
“跟孟子搬家” can naturally mean that the mother moves house together with Mencius.
The city/home contrast can be a natural expected-versus-actual contrast, and the proposed text still has the teacher-marked “孟子老师的家” instead of “孟子老师的家里”.
The recently mentioned mother should be referred to as “她,” but “她认为” is still cut off without its complement.
The mother is the immediately preceding referent, so repeating “孟子的妈妈” should be replaced with “她.”
The two events are already clearly sequential without a required connector, and the proposed text still contains the teacher-marked “孟子老师的家” error.
